software_text:
Programming and developing software are my primary areas of expertise. From years of working as a self-taught coder I've gathered experience in a variety of fields, such as desktop and web app development, low-level systems, graphics programming and game engines. I'm also well aware of the rapidly evolving field of AI and the possibilities it offers.

I understand the principles of software development beyond just coding skills, as I have experience deploying software products in the real world, using version control, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. Alongside my pre-existing knowledge I'm a quick and motivated learner, capable of critical thinking and problem-solving in both familiar and completely foreign environments.

media_text: Alongside programming, I'm interested in almost every other kind of digital creation too. I edit videos with DaVinci Resolve, produce music with FL Studio, and create 3D models and animations with Blender (such as this background video). I do photography as a hobby and use Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop for image processing. I also have experience developing video games with Godot Engine.
journalism_text: I have also worked for two years as a freelance reporter for Lapuan Sanomat. Writing for a local newspaper has given me a lot of experience on interacting with people in a professional setting and collaborating together with coworkers to produce the best content possible. It's given me an outlet for creative writing and an understanding on how to present information in a form accessible for everybody, while making sure the end result is as interesting as possible specifically for our readers.
